meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 菜单栏加一个常驻闪电图标,用绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行、红点表示已停止,并可从图标处启动、停止、重启服务。
howto.when: 仅在 macOS 上使用,且需要 Xcode Command Line Tools(swiftc);当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器时触发。

say.note: 用 launchctl list 检查是否已有 PID

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent bolt icon to the macOS menu bar: a green dot means NanoClaw is running, red means stopped. From the icon you can start, stop, or restart the service.
howto.when_en: macOS only, and requires Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc). Triggered when you ask to add a menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Check whether the NanoClaw menu bar indicator is installed
say_en.note: Uses launchctl list to look for a PID

say_en.text: Uninstall the NanoClaw menu bar status indicator
